name: cold-email
description: Write, review and check one-to-one business cold emails. Writes short sequences from your offer using only your facts; reviews a draft and returns the rewrite first, with every number, name and claim kept; checks an email before sending for merge fields, opt-out and sender lines, country rules and sender setup from records you paste; turns prospect notes, or up to 3 public pages you link, into opening lines. It never sends, creates drafts, finds addresses or adds contacts to any tool.
